svg.data-weight-note: 7.05 lb (3.2 kg), Table 26; 3.12 kg in the datasheet
svg.data-poe-standard: PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at) on all 12 ports, 30 W per port
svg.data-power-input: 100 to 240 VAC at 4 A, 50 to 60 Hz (Table 34)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C at sea level, 0 to 40 C up to 1500 m, 0 to 35 C up to 3000 m
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 6 EX4000 switches; the two Virtual Chassis ports are SFP+ and VC formation is not supported with a 10GBASE-T transceiver in them
svg.data-uplink-ports: two SFP+ ports take 1 GbE or 10 GbE transceivers
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the two Virtual Chassis ports and the two uplink ports are 1GE or 10GE SFP+ ports (Table 11 and Figure 5 callout 10). Virtual Chassis is supported only with 10GE SFP+, and not with a 10GBASE-T transceiver in a Virtual Chassis port. Industrial-grade optics are required above 35 C for under-the-desk mounting and above 40 C otherwise
svg.data-oob: management Ethernet RJ-45 on the front panel, with a link activity lamp and a status lamp
svg.data-console: RJ-45 console on the front panel, labelled CON
svg.data-usb: one USB 2.0 Type-A port on the front panel

g.data-description: Table 27 - green steady: the switch has booted, no alarms; green blinking: booting; amber: minor alarm; red: major alarm; blue: short press of the pinhole reset button; purple: long press
g.data-states: off booted booting minor major reset-short reset-long
g.title: led-sys

circle.data-states: off booted booting minor major reset-short reset-long

g.data-description: Tables 29 and 30 - standalone: green steady is normal, unlit is powered off or halted. Virtual Chassis: green master, yellow backup, white linecard, the blink count giving the member ID
